nodes.text: 9 . 1 The storage contract
nodes.zh: 9.1 存储契约

nodes.text: Storage stores each commit all or nothing and answers lookups and paged scans; every other rule belongs to the Session.
nodes.zh: 存储要么完整保存每一次提交，要么什么都不保存，并响应查找和分页扫描；其余规则都归 Session。

nodes.text: Everything a Session commits ends up in storage: a SQLite file, a directory of text files, or memory. A commit is an atomic save: everything in it is stored together, or nothing is. Storage must keep each commit that way and answer exact lookups and paged scans. That is nearly all Pi Durable asks of it. After this section you can say what storage promises, which rules belong to the Session instead, and what to do when a commit fails.
nodes.zh: Session 提交的一切最终都进入存储：一个 SQLite 文件、一个文本文件目录，或内存。提交是一次原子保存：其中的内容要么一起存下，要么都不存。存储必须让每次提交保持这种状态，并响应精确查找和分页扫描。这几乎就是 Pi Durable 对它的全部要求。读完本节，你就能说出存储承诺了什么、哪些规则改归 Session，以及提交失败时该怎么办。

nodes.text: A small interface with a narrow job
nodes.zh: 一个职责狭窄的小接口

nodes.text: A backend is any object that implements the Storage interface from src/types.ts. Three ship with the package: SqliteStorage, JsonlStorage and MemoryStorage (SQLite (p. 144), JSONL (p. 148), memory (p. 152)). You pick one and hand it to the Harness. From then on only the Session calls it, and every write goes through a commit (the commit and the mutation line (p. 29)).
nodes.zh: 后端就是任何实现了 `src/types.ts` 中 Storage 接口的对象。包里附带三个：`SqliteStorage`、`JsonlStorage` 和 `MemoryStorage`（SQLite（见第 144 页）、JSONL（见第 148 页）、内存（见第 152 页））。你挑一个交给 Harness。此后只有 Session 会调用它，每次写入都走一次提交（提交与变更线，见第 29 页）。

nodes.text: The work is split on purpose. The Session checks meaning: valid records, references, ancestry and task transitions. Storage checks only what it can check alone: that a batch is atomic, that IDs are unique, that immutable records stay immutable, and that it hands back copies src/types.ts. Storage never sees a document definition; it stores document edits as given and replays them only to answer a read. The Session already runs commits one at a time, so a backend needs no lock of its own spec §10.
nodes.zh: 这样的分工是有意为之。Session 检查语义：记录是否合法、引用、祖先关系和任务状态转移。存储只检查它能独立检查的东西：一个批次是否原子、ID 是否唯一、不可变记录是否保持不可变，以及它交还的是副本（`src/types.ts`）。存储从不看到文档定义；它按给定的方式存储文档编辑，只在响应读取时重放它们。Session 本身已经一次只跑一个提交，所以后端不需要自己的锁（spec §10）。

nodes.text: Everything the Session stores goes through one call; everything it reads is a keyed lookup or a cursor scan. The eight write types and the methods of Storage in src/types.ts. The cursor shown is the shape all three shipped backends use.
nodes.zh: Session 存储的一切都经过一次调用；它读取的一切都是按键查找或游标扫描。图中是 `src/types.ts` 里 Storage 的八种写入类型与方法。所示的游标是三个已发布后端都采用的形态。

nodes.text: One write: commit
nodes.zh: 唯一的写入：提交

nodes.text: commit(writes, context) stores a batch of writes atomically and returns its Seq, the commit’s sequence number. Sequences “strictly increase but may have gaps”, and once commit() resolves, every later read sees the batch spec §10. Storage stamps the sequence onto what it keeps. That is how a document can later be read as it was when a given entry was written (bases, deltas and migrations (p. 56)).
nodes.zh: `commit(writes, context)` 原子地存储一批写入，并返回它的 `Seq`，即该提交的序号。序号「严格递增，但可能有间隔」，而一旦 `commit()` resolve，之后的每次读取都能看到这一批（spec §10）。存储把序号盖在它保存的内容上。正是这样，文档后来才能被读回某个条目写入时的样子（基线、增量与迁移，见第 56 页）。

nodes.text: When a commit fails Only one kind of failure is safe. StorageRejected “means a batch was rejected before any durable effect and is guaranteed not to have committed”. The Session rolls back and carries on. Any other error from commit() poisons the Session: it can no longer know whether the batch was stored, so it refuses further commits spec §10. What poison means for your host is in when a commit fails (p. 33).
nodes.zh: 提交失败时：只有一种失败是安全的。`StorageRejected` 「意味着某批次在任何持久效果发生之前就被拒绝，并且保证没有提交」。Session 会回滚并继续。`commit()` 抛出的任何其他错误都会毒化 Session：它再也无法知道该批次是否已存储，于是拒绝后续提交（spec §10）。毒化对你的宿主意味着什么，见「提交失败时」（第 33 页）。

nodes.text: Reads: keyed lookups and paged scans
nodes.zh: 读取：按键查找与分页扫描

nodes.text: A keyed lookup returns one record, or undefined. A scan returns a page, { items, next? }; pass next back to get the following page. The cursor is opaque: pass it back only to the same scan on the same storage spec §10. The Harness reads 256 items per page, and every read it makes has an index behind it spec §10.
nodes.zh: 按键查找返回一条记录，或 `undefined`。扫描返回一页 `{ items, next? }`；把 `next` 传回去即可取下一页。游标是不透明的：只能把它传回同一存储上的同一次扫描（spec §10）。Harness 每页读 256 项，而它发起的每次读取背后都有索引（spec §10）。

nodes.text: document(id, at) is the one read that computes. It finds the newest base at or before the point, applies the deltas after it in order, and returns the value. At "current" a retired incarnation returns undefined. Asking for an old point of a document that keeps no history fails rather than guessing (defining a document (p. 50)).
nodes.zh: `document(id, at)` 是唯一需要计算的读取。它找到该时点或之前最新的基线，按序应用其后的增量，然后返回值。在 `"current"` 处，已退场的化身返回 `undefined`。若一个不保留历史的文档被问到旧的时点，则直接失败而不是猜测（定义文档，见第 50 页）。

nodes.text: You rarely call storage yourself. Choose a backend, open it, and pass it to the Harness. A commit error other than StorageRejected poisons the Session. Close it and reopen the storage; the reopened state is the truth. Writing a backend? Pass the conformance suite (9.4 (p. 152)).
nodes.zh: 你很少自己调用存储。挑一个后端，打开它，交给 Harness。除 `StorageRejected` 之外的提交错误会毒化 Session。把它关掉再重新打开存储；重新打开后的状态才是真相。要写一个后端？把一致性测试套件传进去（9.4，见第 152 页）。

nodes.text: Details for backend authors All records share one ID space from mintId(); ID 1 is the root conversation. A batch holds at most one create or change per document incarnation, plus an optional retirement, and a version change must be a base spec §10. Keep nothing from the arguments after commit() settles, and return detached values spec §4.
nodes.zh: 后端作者需要知道的细节：所有记录共享同一个 ID 空间，来自 `mintId()`；ID 1 是根会话。一个批次对每个文档化身最多包含一次 create 或 change，外加一次可选的退场，且版本变更必须是基线（spec §10）。`commit()` 结束之后不要保留参数里的任何东西，并返回彼此独立的值（spec §4）。

9 . 2 SQLite
nodes.zh: 9.2 SQLite

nodes.text: One SQL transaction is one commit; every record is kept whole as JSON beside the few columns its queries need.
nodes.zh: 一个 SQL 事务就是一次提交；每条记录都以 JSON 完整保存，查询所需的少数几列放在旁边。

nodes.text: SQLite keeps a whole Session in one file. It is the backend for anything that must survive a restart. After this section you can open a database, find any record with an ordinary SQLite client, predict what a crash or a power cut costs, and run the same backend outside Node.
nodes.zh: SQLite 把整个 Session 装在一个文件里。任何必须跨重启存活的东西都该用它。读完本节，你就能打开一个数据库、用普通的 SQLite 客户端找到任意一条记录、预判一次崩溃或断电会损失什么，并在 Node 之外运行同一个后端。

nodes.text: Opening a file
nodes.zh: 打开文件

nodes.text: openNodeSqliteStorage(path, options) from @earendil-works/pi-durable/storage/sqlite/node creates the parent directory and opens the file with Node’s built-in node:sqlite. It turns on write-ahead logging (journal_mode = WAL, synchronous = NORMAL) and applies any pending schema migrations src/storage/sqlite/node.ts.
nodes.zh: `openNodeSqliteStorage(path, options)` 来自 `@earendil-works/pi-durable/storage/sqlite/node`，它会创建父目录，并用 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite` 打开文件。它开启预写日志（`journal_mode = WAL`、`synchronous = NORMAL`），并应用任何待执行的 schema 迁移（`src/storage/sqlite/node.ts`）。

nodes.text: Those settings decide what survives. “WAL mode with synchronous = NORMAL: commits survive process crashes; the newest may be lost on power or host failure” README §Storage. One SQL transaction is one commit, so a process that dies mid-commit leaves all of it or none of it spec §11.2. close() folds the write-ahead log back into the file. After a close, the capture found a single session.sqlite and no WAL file research/capture/extra-p9/sqlite-revisions.txt.
nodes.zh: 这些设置决定了什么能存活。「WAL 模式且 `synchronous = NORMAL`：提交可挺过进程崩溃；最新的可能在断电或宿主故障时丢失」（README §Storage）。一个 SQL 事务就是一次提交，所以进程若在提交中途死掉，结果是全有或全无（spec §11.2）。`close()` 会把预写日志折回文件里。close 之后，采集结果显示只有一个 `session.sqlite`，没有 WAL 文件（`research/capture/extra-p9/sqlite-revisions.txt`）。

nodes.text: One commit, one transaction
nodes.zh: 一次提交，一个事务

nodes.text: SqliteStorage.commit() checks document commands in memory, then runs one SQL transaction: it reads the next sequence number, checks each new ID and document command, writes the rows, and advances the counters. If anything throws, the transaction rolls back and no sequence number is used src/storage/sqlite/storage.ts. mintId() is an in-memory counter, not a write. An ID minted by a transaction that later failed may be handed out again after a reopen. That is safe: only IDs in a committed write must never be reused (invariant 5 (p. 16)).
nodes.zh: `SqliteStorage.commit()` 先在内存里检查文档命令，然后运行一个 SQL 事务：读出下一个序号，检查每个新 ID 与文档命令，写入各行，并推进计数器。如果任何环节抛出异常，事务回滚，那个序号也不会被用掉（`src/storage/sqlite/storage.ts`）。`mintId()` 是内存计数器，不是写入。由一个后来失败的事务铸出的 ID，在重新打开后可能再次发出。这是安全的：只有已提交写入中的 ID 才绝不可复用（不变式 5，见第 16 页）。

nodes.text: Document revisions
nodes.zh: 文档修订

nodes.text: Document content lives in document_revisions, one row per document per commit that changed it. A row is either a base, holding the complete value, or a delta, holding the Chord operations. To read a document, SQLite finds the newest base at or before the point and applies the deltas after it, inside one transaction so a concurrent commit cannot swap the base src/storage/sqlite/storage.ts.
nodes.zh: 文档内容存放在 document_revisions，每个文档每次改动它的提交占一行。一行要么是基线，保存完整值；要么是增量，保存 Chord 操作。要读取一个文档，SQLite 找到该时点或之前最新的基线，在同一个事务内应用其后的增量，这样并发提交无法调包基线（`src/storage/sqlite/storage.ts`）。

nodes.text: A rewindable document keeps every revision; a current-only document drops its older rows when a base commits. Rows and reads from research/capture/extra-p9/sqlite-revisions.txt: two app documents changed in the same commits, seq 2–7.

Whether history is kept depends on the document. A rewindable document keeps every row, so document(2, 4) rebuilds the value as of seq 4 from the base at 2 and two deltas. Every other document is current-only: when a new base commits, the same transaction deletes its older rows. That is why each built-in document of the one-turn run ends as a single base row research/capture/sqlite-rows.txt. Every one of these reads is an indexed search; the capture’s query plans show no table scans research/capture/extra-p9/sqlite-revisions.txt.
nodes.zh: 是否保留历史取决于文档。可回溯的文档保留每一行，因此 `document(2, 4)` 会从 2 处的基线加两个增量重建出 seq 4 时的值。其他文档都只保留当前值：新基线提交时，同一个事务会删除它较旧的行。这就是那一轮运行中每个内置文档最终都只剩一行基线的原因（`research/capture/sqlite-rows.txt`）。这里每一次读取都是索引查找；采集到的查询计划显示没有表扫描（`research/capture/extra-p9/sqlite-revisions.txt`）。

nodes.text: Beyond Node
nodes.zh: Node 之外

nodes.text: The SQLite core needs no Node API. SqliteStorage.open(db) from @earendil-works/pi-durable/storage/sqlite accepts any object that implements SqliteDatabase. The same backend then runs wherever someone writes a small adapter, “for example on Bun or in Cloudflare Durable Objects” README §Storage.

nodes.text: The adapter’s rules are short but strict. Inside a transaction, use only the handle the callback receives; it is invalid once the callback settles. Other work waits until the transaction finishes, so calling the database itself from inside a callback never settles. If the callback rejects, roll back and reject with the same error. If the rollback fails too, reject with a different error, such as an AggregateError, “so callers cannot mistake the callback error for a guaranteed rollback” src/storage/sqlite/database.ts. Schema changes are versioned migrations, applied in one transaction when the file opens. There is one so far, version 1. A file written by a newer package is refused (“Durable SQLite schema version 2 is newer than supported version 1”), and a failed migration rolls back with the data intact src/storage/sqlite/migrations.ts; test/sqlite-migrations.test.ts.
nodes.zh: 适配器的规则简短但严格。在事务内部，只能使用回调收到的那个句柄；回调结束后它就失效了。其他工作要等事务完成，所以在回调内部调用数据库本身永远不会 settle。如果回调 reject，就回滚并以同一个错误 reject。如果回滚也失败，就以另一个错误 reject，比如一个 AggregateError，「以免调用方把回调错误误认为已保证回滚」（`src/storage/sqlite/database.ts`）。Schema 变更是有版本号的迁移，在文件打开时于一个事务内应用。目前只有一个，版本 1。由更新版本包写出的文件会被拒绝（「Durable SQLite schema version 2 is newer than supported version 1」），迁移失败则回滚且数据完好（`src/storage/sqlite/migrations.ts`；`test/sqlite-migrations.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: “One process owns a storage at a time; there is no cross-process locking” README §Storage. Each SqliteStorage mints IDs from its own counter, so two processes on one file can mint the same ID. The second commit then fails and poisons that Session, or silently replaces the other process’s task or submission. Running a single owner is the host’s job (limits and non-goals (p. 168)).
nodes.zh: 「同一时刻只有一个进程拥有一个存储；没有跨进程锁」（README §Storage）。每个 SqliteStorage 都从自己的计数器铸出 ID，所以两个进程操作同一个文件可能铸出相同的 ID。于是第二次提交会失败并毒化那个 Session，或者悄悄替换掉另一个进程的任务或提交项。只运行单一所有者是宿主的职责（限制与非目标，见第 168 页）。

nodes.text: Use SQLite for anything long-lived. A process crash loses nothing committed; a power cut may lose the newest commits. To debug, open the file with any SQLite client and read the record column. On another runtime, write a SqliteDatabase adapter and run the conformance suite against it.
nodes.zh: 任何长期存在的东西都用 SQLite。进程崩溃不会丢失任何已提交内容；断电可能丢掉最新的提交。调试时，用任意 SQLite 客户端打开文件并读 record 列。在其他运行时上，写一个 SqliteDatabase 适配器并对它跑一致性测试套件。

nodes.zh: 9.3 JSONL

nodes.text: Sidecar records first, one marker in main.jsonl second: a commit exists exactly when its marker does.
nodes.zh: 先写边车记录，再在 main.jsonl 写一个标记：标记存在，提交就存在。

nodes.text: JSONL storage is a directory of plain text files you can read with cat. It suits development and debugging, where seeing every record matters more than speed. After this section you can read the files, say what a crash can lose, and decide whether to turn on fsync.
nodes.zh: JSONL 存储是一个纯文本文件目录，你可以用 cat 直接读。它适合开发和调试，那里看得见每条记录比速度更重要。读完本节，你就能读这些文件、说出一次崩溃可能损失什么，并决定是否打开 fsync。

nodes.text: The directory
nodes.zh: 目录

nodes.text: openNodeJsonlStorage(directory, context, options) from /storage/jsonl/node opens or creates the directory. On another runtime, JsonlStorage.open(directory, fs, context, options) from /storage/jsonl does the same over any FileSystem (the execution environment (p. 155)). Every line is one JSON object, in one of three kinds of file spec §11.3: main.jsonl — one marker line per commit. It only grows. doc-<id>.jsonl — the content of one document: its bases and deltas. task-<id>.jsonl — the successive records of one live task. It is deleted when the task finishes. The document and task files are sidecars: they hold the bulky, changing data. A marker carries small records in full, such as entries and a task’s final record. For the rest it carries a pointer: a file plus an ordinal that numbers the commit’s sidecar lines from 0 src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts.
nodes.zh: `openNodeJsonlStorage(directory, context, options)` 来自 /storage/jsonl/node，打开或创建该目录。在其他运行时上，/storage/jsonl 里的 `JsonlStorage.open(directory, fs, context, options)` 通过任意 FileSystem 做同样的事（执行环境，见第 155 页）。每一行是一个 JSON 对象，分布在三类文件中（spec §11.3）：main.jsonl —— 每次提交一行标记，只增不减。doc-<id>.jsonl —— 一个文档的内容：它的基线与增量。task-<id>.jsonl —— 一个活跃任务先后留下的记录，任务结束时被删除。文档文件和任务文件是边车：它们保存体积大、易变的数据。标记完整携带小记录，比如条目和任务的最终记录；其余它只携带一个指针：一个文件加上一个序位，后者从 0 起为该提交的边车行编号（`src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts`）。

nodes.text: Every commit follows the same three steps spec §11.3: 1. append the commit’s records to every affected sidecar; 2. append one complete marker to main.jsonl listing those records; 3. only then make the commit visible to reads.

A batch that fails validation touches no file. Once writing has begun, any failed append or flush poisons the backend: every call rejects with JsonlStoragePoisonedError until you reopen, and the Session is poisoned too (2.3 (p. 33)).

nodes.text: The fsync option decides what survives, and it defaults to false. Without it, JSONL survives a process crash, but not a power, kernel or disk failure. With fsync: true, each sidecar is flushed to disk before its marker is written. The newest commits can still vanish in a power cut, “but a marker that survives should not overtake its sidecar data” spec §11.3.
nodes.zh: fsync 选项决定什么能存活，默认为 false。不开启它，JSONL 能挺过进程崩溃，但挺不过断电、内核或磁盘故障。开启 `fsync: true` 后，每个边车会在其标记写入之前被刷新到磁盘。最新的提交在断电时仍可能消失，「但一个存活的标记不应越过它的边车数据」（spec §11.3）。

nodes.text: Recovery
nodes.zh: 恢复

nodes.text: Opening a directory is a recovery pass, and its rules are short spec §11.3; src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts: Torn lines — a file that does not end in a newline is cut back to its last newline. Unconfirmed records — a sidecar line counts only if a marker names it. Unconfirmed lines at the end are cut. Corruption — a confirmed line that is missing, out of order, or after an unconfirmed one fails the open with JsonlCorruptionError (unless a later base made it unnecessary). Nothing repairs it spec §13. Leftovers — files from an interrupted reclamation are deleted, and any reclamation still owed is done.
nodes.zh: 打开一个目录就是一次恢复过程，规则很短（spec §11.3；`src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts`）：残缺行 —— 文件末尾没有换行的部分会被截回最后一个换行处。未确认的记录 —— 只有被标记指名的边车行才算数，末尾未确认的行被截掉。损坏 —— 一条已确认的行若缺失、乱序，或位于未确认行之后，打开会以 JsonlCorruptionError 失败（除非后续一个基线让它变得无关紧要）。没有任何机制会修复它（spec §13）。残留 —— 被中断的回收留下的文件会被删除，任何仍欠着的回收会被补做。

nodes.text: Reclamation
nodes.zh: 回收

nodes.text: Reclamation deletes sidecar lines that a newer base, a retirement or a finished task made unnecessary, only after that commit spec §11.3. Rewindable documents are never reclaimed. If reclamation fails, the commit stays published and the next open finishes the job src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts.
nodes.zh: 回收会删除那些因更新的基线、退场或已完成的任务而变得多余的边车行，且只在该提交之后（spec §11.3）。可回溯的文档永不回收。如果回收失败，提交仍保持已发布状态，下一次打开会补完这件事（`src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts`）。

nodes.text: A process crash never leaves half a commit. A commit exists exactly when its marker line is complete. Turn on fsync: true if the files must survive a power cut in a consistent state. Expect slow opens on large stores (9.4 (p. 152)).
nodes.zh: 进程崩溃绝不会留下半个提交。标记行完整，提交就存在。如果文件必须挺过断电并保持一致状态，打开 fsync: true。在大型存储上打开会很慢（9.4，见第 152 页）。

nodes.text: 9 . 4 Memory, conformance and portability
nodes.zh: 9.4 内存、一致性与可移植性

nodes.text: MemoryStorage defines what every backend means, one shared test suite checks it, and the storage cores run wherever an adapter can.
nodes.zh: MemoryStorage 定义了每个后端的含义，一套共享测试套件来检验它，而存储内核在任何能写适配器的地方都能运行。

nodes.text: The three backends are interchangeable because they are held to one reference and one test suite. After this section you can choose a backend from measured costs, test your own backend with the shared suite, and run storage on a runtime other than Node.
nodes.zh: 这三个后端之所以可以互换，是因为它们都被同一份参考实现和同一套测试套件约束。读完本节，你就能根据实测代价挑选后端、用共享套件测试自己的后端，并在 Node 以外的运行时上运行存储。

nodes.text: MemoryStorage is the reference
nodes.zh: MemoryStorage 是参考实现

nodes.text: Memory storage defines what the others must do. It copies every record it keeps and every record it returns: “This deliberately simulates the ownership boundary naturally created by SQLite encoding/decoding and JSONL serialization” spec §11.1. So a caller that mutates a record it read cannot change storage, on memory or on disk. Memory storage also keeps or drops document history exactly as the durable backends do. A test that reads an old point of a current-only document fails on memory just as it would on SQLite. Memory storage persists nothing. Use it for tests, examples and short-lived sessions. Most examples in test/examples run on it; the recovery and restart examples (ex 13, 23, 24, 31) use SQLite, and ex 17 uses JSONL. JSONL also uses memory storage internally to answer every read src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts.
nodes.zh: 内存存储定义了其他后端必须做到的事。它复制自己保存的每一条记录和返回的每一条记录：「这是刻意模拟 SQLite 编解码和 JSONL 序列化自然形成的所有权边界」（spec §11.1）。因此，修改自己读到的记录的调用方无法改动存储，无论在内存里还是在磁盘上。内存存储对文档历史的保留或丢弃，也与持久后端完全一致。一个读取只保留当前值的文档旧时点的测试，在内存上和在 SQLite 上一样会失败。内存存储不持久化任何东西。用它做测试、示例和短生命周期的 Session。test/examples 中的大多数示例跑在它上面；恢复与重启示例（ex 13、23、24、31）用 SQLite，ex 17 用 JSONL。JSONL 内部也用内存存储来响应每次读取（`src/storage/jsonl/storage.ts`）。

nodes.text: The suite has 23 cases. They cover the ID space, atomic batches and detached values, entries and forks, conversation and task scans, submissions, document history and addresses, and lossless string keys src/testing/storage-conformance.ts. The package runs it five times: on memory, SQLite and JSONL, and on SQLite and JSONL closed and reopened after every commit. The suite pins meaning, not mechanics. Crash recovery, flush order and query plans are tested per backend, and a custom backend needs its own tests for them.

nodes.text: 9 . 5 The execution environment
nodes.zh: 9.5 执行环境

nodes.text: Tools touch files and processes only through an ExecutionEnv the host builds for each use, so where a conversation runs is the host’s decision, not the tool’s.
nodes.zh: 工具只通过宿主为每次使用构建的 ExecutionEnv 触达文件与进程，所以会话在哪里运行是宿主的决定，不是工具的。

nodes.text: Your agent’s tools read files and run commands. The execution environment decides where: your own disk, a sandbox directory per user, or a remote container. Tools never touch the machine directly; they go through an ExecutionEnv that the host builds each time one is needed. After this section you can give each conversation its own sandbox, implement the interface for a remote host, and know what the built-in tools expect.
nodes.zh: 你的智能体工具读文件、跑命令。执行环境决定在哪里：你自己的磁盘、每用户一个沙箱目录，或一个远程容器。工具从不直接接触机器；它们通过一个 ExecutionEnv，由宿主在每次需要时构建。读完本节，你就能给每个会话一个自己的沙箱、为远程宿主实现这个接口，并知道内置工具期待什么。

nodes.text: Built at each use
nodes.zh: 每次使用时构建

nodes.text: The host supplies one function, HarnessOptions.env. The Harness calls it whenever work needs an environment, never on the Session line, and it may be async src/harness/types.ts. It receives the conversationId, the conversation’s working directory cwd if one is set in its pi.agent document (the per-conversation agent (p. 106)), and read, which reads committed documents.
nodes.zh: 宿主提供一个函数，HarnessOptions.env。Harness 在任何工作需要环境时才调用它，绝不在 Session 那一行调用，且它可以是 async（`src/harness/types.ts`）。它会收到 conversationId、该会话的工作目录 cwd（如果它的 pi.agent 文档里设置了的话，见每会话智能体，第 106 页），以及 read，后者用于读取已提交的文档。

nodes.text: Tools, prompt sections and task phases reach files and processes only through an environment the host builds per use from committed state. Callers from README §Environment and src/harness/{tool,generation,scheduler}.ts; the target from src/harness/types.ts.
nodes.zh: 工具、提示词段落和任务阶段只能通过一个环境触达文件与进程，而这个环境由宿主每次使用时依据已提交状态构建。调用方见 README §Environment 和 `src/harness/{tool,generation,scheduler}.ts`；目标见 `src/harness/types.ts`。

nodes.text: Three kinds of work ask for it. A tool call receives it as api.env (defining tools (p. 112)). A system-prompt section receives it as input.env (the system prompt (p. 115)). Any task phase can ask with runtime.env(). Returning undefined is allowed: the built-in tools then fail with an error result, “No execution environment is configured”. A throw from env also becomes the tool call’s error result README §Environment; src/tools/env.ts. Because the environment is built per use, a tool call rerun after a crash gets a fresh one, “with the conversation’s current cwd, which may differ from the first attempt’s” spec §12. Build it only from committed state, as example 29 does to give each conversation its own sandbox:
nodes.zh: 有三类工作会索要它。工具调用通过 api.env 接收它（定义工具，见第 112 页）。系统提示词的一个段落通过 input.env 接收它（系统提示词，见第 115 页）。任何任务阶段都可以用 runtime.env() 索取。允许返回 undefined：此时内置工具会以一个错误结果失败，「没有配置执行环境」。env 抛出的异常同样会变成该工具调用的错误结果（README §Environment；`src/tools/env.ts`）。因为环境是每次使用时构建的，崩溃后重跑的工具调用会拿到一个全新的环境，「带着该会话当前的 cwd，可能与第一次尝试不同」（spec §12）。只依据已提交状态构建它，如示例 29 那样为每个会话配一个自己的沙箱：

nodes.text: The interface
nodes.zh: 接口

nodes.text: ExecutionEnv is a FileSystem plus a Shell, from @earendil-works/pi-durable/env. Every operation returns a result instead of throwing: { ok: true, value } or { ok: false, error }, where the error carries a code such as not_found or timeout src/env/index.ts.
nodes.zh: ExecutionEnv 是一个 FileSystem 加一个 Shell，来自 `@earendil-works/pi-durable/env`。每个操作都返回结果而不抛出：`{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error }`，其中 error 带一个 code，比如 not_found 或 timeout（`src/env/index.ts`）。

nodes.text: id names the file namespace: “equal ids see the same files at the same paths, whatever their cwd” src/env/index.ts. Every local NodeExecutionEnv uses "node:local"; each container or remote host needs its own. The id lets the host build a new environment object per call. The built-in edit and write tools still take turns on one file, because they queue by id plus path. That queue is per process and “not a lock against bash or other processes” src/tools/file-mutation-queue.ts.
nodes.zh: id 指明文件命名空间：「相同的 id 无论 cwd 是什么，都看到相同路径上的相同文件」（`src/env/index.ts`）。每个本地 NodeExecutionEnv 都用 "node:local"；每个容器或远程宿主都需要自己的。id 让宿主可以为每次调用构建一个新的环境对象。内置的编辑与写工具在同一个文件上仍然是轮流的，因为它们按 id 加路径排队。那条队列是进程内的，「不是针对 bash 或其他进程的锁」（`src/tools/file-mutation-queue.ts`）。

nodes.text: Running commands
nodes.zh: 运行命令

nodes.text: exec(command, options, context) takes a string or an array. A string runs through a shell; NodeExecutionEnv uses bash, falling back to sh -c. An array runs command[0] directly with the rest as its arguments, so they reach the program exactly as given src/env/index.ts; src/env/node.ts. Prefer the array form when arguments come from the model or a user. In NodeExecutionEnv, timeout is in seconds, and a nonzero exit is a successful result with its exitCode. onOutput receives each chunk, tagged stdout or stderr. Aborting the context kills that command; cleanup() kills everything left, at shutdown.
nodes.zh: `exec(command, options, context)` 接受字符串或数组。字符串通过 shell 运行；NodeExecutionEnv 用 bash，回退到 sh -c。数组则直接运行 command[0]，其余作为它的参数，因此原样传到程序（`src/env/index.ts`；`src/env/node.ts`）。当参数来自模型或用户时，优先用数组形式。在 NodeExecutionEnv 中，timeout 的单位是秒，非零退出是一个成功结果，带上它的 exitCode。onOutput 接收每一个数据块，标记为 stdout 或 stderr。中止 context 会杀掉那条命令；cleanup() 在关闭时杀掉所有残留。

nodes.text: Output windows
nodes.zh: 输出窗口

nodes.text: A tool that keeps only the tail of a command’s output can say so, and a remote environment can then skip sending the rest. The caller passes a window (maxBytes, maxLines and pacing limits). The environment may drop output outside that tail, reporting what it dropped on the next chunk as info.skipped src/env/index.ts; CHANGELOG 1.0.3.
nodes.zh: 只保留命令输出末尾的工具可以明说这一点，远程环境随后就能跳过发送其余部分。调用方传入一个窗口（maxBytes、maxLines 以及节奏限制）。环境可以丢弃该末尾之外的输出，并在下一个数据块上用 info.skipped 报告丢弃了什么（`src/env/index.ts`；CHANGELOG 1.0.3）。

nodes.text: A windowed exec may drop output the caller would drop anyway, and counts exactly what it dropped. The rule of info.skipped (src/env/index.ts) and the conformance case that prints 2,000 lines through a 200-byte, 5-line window.
nodes.zh: 带窗口的 exec 可能丢弃调用方本来也会丢弃的输出，并精确统计自己丢弃了多少。info.skipped 的规则（`src/env/index.ts`）以及一致性用例中通过一个 200 字节、5 行的窗口打印 2,000 行的那一条。

nodes.text: Skipping is safe because of one rule: the chunk after a skip always holds more than the window, so dropped text can never belong in the kept tail. The built-in bash tool uses windows src/harness/tool.ts; src/tools/bash.ts. NodeExecutionEnv ignores window and delivers everything; windows pay off when output crosses a network. A tool wrapper that transforms output must turn the window off, or skipped text would bypass its transform (defining tools (p. 112)).
nodes.zh: 跳过是安全的，靠的是一条规则：紧跟跳过之后的数据块总是多于窗口，所以被丢弃的文本永远不可能属于保留的末尾。内置 bash 工具使用窗口（`src/harness/tool.ts`；`src/tools/bash.ts`）。NodeExecutionEnv 忽略 window 并送出全部内容；窗口在输出跨越网络时才划算。会变换输出的工具包装器必须关掉窗口，否则被跳过的文本会绕过它的变换（定义工具，见第 112 页）。

nodes.text: To isolate conversations, return a different environment per conversation from HarnessOptions.env. Return undefined to switch file and shell tools off. Build the environment only from committed state: a rerun after a crash builds it again. For a custom environment, implement FileSystem and Shell, return failures as results, give each file namespace its own id, and run registerEnvConformance from /testing, which has 21 cases.
nodes.zh: 要隔离会话，就从 HarnessOptions.env 为每个会话返回不同的环境。返回 undefined 会关掉文件与 shell 工具。只依据已提交状态构建环境：崩溃后重跑会重新构建。自定义环境要实现 FileSystem 和 Shell，以结果形式返回失败，给每个文件命名空间自己的 id，并运行来自 /testing 的 `registerEnvConformance`，它有 21 个用例。

nodes.text: Details: capabilities added in 1.0.3 Version 1.0.3 made four capabilities mandatory, so custom environments must add them CHANGELOG 1.0.3. openBinaryReader(path, { noFollow? }) reads one opened file by position, and its scanLines() finds a span of lines in one pass; the read tool uses both. openDirReader(path) pages through a directory. watch(targets, onChange) reports changed paths, an overflow (rescan everything) or an error. And exec accepts the array form.
nodes.zh: 细节：1.0.3 新增的能力。1.0.3 把四项能力设为必需，因此自定义环境必须补上它们（CHANGELOG 1.0.3）。openBinaryReader(path, { noFollow? }) 按位置读取一个已打开的文件，它的 scanLines() 一趟就能找到一段行；read 工具两者都用。openDirReader(path) 分页遍历目录。watch(targets, onChange) 报告变化的路径、溢出（需全部重扫）或错误。而 exec 接受数组形式。
